messages:
alex_cheng: Quick ask: can someone run an overnight microbench sweep comparing H100 vs A100 vs L40S for 8k longctx (causal) at batch sizes 1/2/4? Need p50/p95/p99, token throughput, and peak GPU mem. Also capture kernel fallbacks. Prefer same AMI + driver.

maria_gomez: I can kick that off tonight. Any specific model and dtype? fp16 vs int8 vs q4? Also which checkpoint/version to pin?

alex_cheng: Use llama2-13b-chat, quant profiles: fp16 baseline, q4f for H100/A100, and int8 for L40S if supported. Sequence length 8192, prompt ~256 tokens. Pin to model:v2.1. Capture perf counters, kernel names, and nvml logs.

maria_gomez: Got it. I'll use container registry.redwood/inference:stable-2026-02-01, driver 535, CUDA 12.2. Running on H100/A100/L40S pools (8x config). ETA morning. @kevin_ops can you ensure nodes are free?

kevin_ops: On it — drained non-critical jobs and bumped cgroup limits. Will open SSH + perf ports and make sure collectors can run. :thumbsup:

benchmark-bot: Benchmark job queued: job_id=bch-20260228-239, estimated runtime ~3h per SKU. Artifacts -> s3://redwood-perf/bench/bch-20260228-239/

samir: Heads up: last sweep (2026-01 baseline) showed kernel fallback on L40S for q4f at seq 8k; may need compiler flag like `--disable-cublaslt` or to force cuBLAS algos. Capture full kernel names in the trace.

maria_gomez: Thanks Samir — I'll enable verbose kernel logging and dump nvml every 30s. Command I'm running:
```
python run_microbench.py \
  --model llama2-13b-chat \
  --model-version v2.1 \
  --seq 8192 \
  --prompt-len 256 \
  --batch-sizes 1,2,4 \
  --dtypes fp16,q4f,int8 \
  --iterations 200 \
  --trace-kernels \
  --nvml-interval 30 \
  --out s3://redwood-perf/bench/bch-20260228-239/\
```

alex_cheng: Perfect. One more: compute p99 latency with 95% CI (bootstrap) and include per-token cost estimate using current instance prices (see https://internal.redwood/pricing/instances). Tag runs with `longctx-8k-2026-02-28`. If regression vs baseline, keep both raw traces for kernel diffing.

maria_gomez: Will do. I'll upload artifacts + a short summary PR to perf-reports when done. :rocket:

kevin_ops: Nodes ready. Starting H100 pool now.

benchmark-bot: H100 run started. job_id=bch-20260228-239-h100

benchmark-bot: A100 run started. job_id=bch-20260228-239-a100

benchmark-bot: L40S run started. job_id=bch-20260228-239-l40s

maria_gomez: If any run fails, please @me and I'll triage in the morning (timezone heads-up: I'll be online 07:00 PST).

alex_cheng: Thanks team. If we find a regression vs 2026-01 baseline, leave both raw traces + kernel logs so Samir can diff.

maria_gomez: Baseline snapshots are in s3://redwood-perf/baselines/2026-01/ — I'll copy them into the run dir as well.

samir: :eyes: I'll look at kernel diffs and check for cublas/cublasLt mismatches. If we see fallback, first suspect is cuBLAS algo change or mem fragmentation.

alex_cheng: Closing loop — ping me with the PR link and short findings thread when uploads complete. Thanks!
